review: Inspected all3 images. Fogo cone, Paul terraces, secular fort/waterfront and salt pans form island montage. Hero and cover pillory was initially generic tan column; researched UNESCO/HPIP description then edited to slender white marble spiral Manueline column with small ironwork and pinecone finial. Avatar follows corrected specification. Natural turtle and shearwater. No restricted religious architecture/symbol identified. Approximate numeric depth fields and representative regional coverage.
